_help: Back End fixes, applied on every 'npm run convert'. Use ids from 'npm run convert -- --list'. same_place: the two entries are one place (keep's position and photo stay; merge's paths and names move to keep). not_same: close pairs that are different places. remove: drop an entry and its paths. change: set name, category, aliases (list), landmark, description or verified. See README.txt.
_notes: faculty_of_technology is the Faculty of Technology BUILDING (Samuel, 23 Oct). Ezekiel had saved the lecture theatre under the same name, so his entry was replaced.
The lecture theatre must be re-saved as 'Faculty of Technology Lecture Theatre' (nicknames: Chemengine, Chem Engine; old name Chemical Engineering Lecture Theatre).
_not_same_help: Pairs under 15 m apart that the team confirmed are DIFFERENT places, so the converter stops asking about them.
